name: carbon-lite
description: CARBON Lite: AI software testing and QA skills for developers and QA engineers, with a portable visual report and no MCP server.

interface.longDescription: CARBON Lite helps developers and QA engineers test software inside their coding agent. Jay, an AI test manager, guides eight bounded workflows: broad assessment, focused feature testing, issue hunting, accessibility, current-run evidence maps, disposable demos, help, and preferences. Talk directly to Jay with /jay or /j. Includes a portable visual Studio report with evidence-backed findings, coverage gaps, and confidence assessments. Uses the coding agent's authorized browser and terminal tools; reports distinguish executed checks from proposed work. Test coverage depends on the available project context, access, and execution tools. No MCP server, OAuth, telemetry, or hosted account. Source-available under PolyForm Perimeter 1.0.0. Not a certification or guarantee that software is defect-free.
defaultPrompt: Assess this project with CARBON Lite.
Review these test results and explain the remaining risks.
